messages:
alice: Heads up — encountered a flaky 429 loop with the py async client. It seems to ignore Retry-After values when the header is suffixed with units (e.g., "Retry-After: 1200ms"). End result: immediate retries + another 429. Anyone seen this?

brian: Hmm. Our parser historically expects integer seconds. Can you paste the exact headers and a minimal repro?

alice: Example from the service: 
```
headers = {
  "x-rate-limit": "100",
  "Retry-After": "1200ms",
  "Quota-Reset": "1670000"
}
# client: await AsyncClient.request(...), on 429 we call _parse_retry_after(headers)
```

carol: I think sync client normalizes to seconds (int). Async path used a looser regex but didn't handle trailing "ms" or the alternate "retry-after-ms" header we get from some infra. We should accept: ints (secs), floats (secs), "123ms", and "retry-after-ms: 123".

dave: I sketched a fix in a draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-py/pull/789 — adds parse_time_delta(header) that understands "ms", "s", plain numbers, and header aliases. Also added a small heuristic: if requested wait < 50ms apply jittered micro-backoff instead of immediate retry to avoid hammering.

ci-bot: CI: test_retry_timing failed on windows-latest — assertion on mocked sleep call count mismatch.

brian: Nice. Two asks before merge: 1) explicit tests for "Retry-After: 1200ms" and "Retry-After-ms: 1200" (both header forms) 2) expose a config option (e.g., "respect_retry_units": true) as a safety toggle for customers who want legacy behavior.

alice: Found another smoking gun: one branch in async backoff calls asyncio.sleep but forgot to await it (typo). That would explain why we didn’t actually pause in some flows and kept retrying. I’ll add that fix to the PR.

carol: Oof — that await-lapse would produce exactly this symptom. Please add a test that asserts sleep was awaited, so Windows/mocking CI catches regressions.

dave: Updated PR with fix + tests; CI green locally. @carol @brian PTAL when you have a moment.

brian: Reviewing now. Also, please add a tiny doc note in the SDK troubleshooting guide: "Retry-After header formats supported" so integrators know what to expect.

alice: Will do. Logging follow-up issue in DevEx board: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/DEVEX-402 — title: handle retry header unit parsing + ensure async sleep is awaited. Thanks all :thumbsup:

ci-bot: CI: draft PR created, checks queued.
